business_problem: OpenAI’s data platform powers one of the fastest-scaling products in tech history. ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and the internal tools used by thousands of OpenAI employees require a foundation that can withstand sudden growth, run governed analytics across multiple business units, and operate across multiple clouds simultaneously.
solution_summary: OpenAI’s data platform powers one of the fastest-scaling products in tech history. ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and the internal tools used by thousands of OpenAI employees require a foundation that can withstand sudden growth, run governed analytics across multiple business units, and operate across multiple clouds simultaneously. That foundation has grown up around Databricks. Since 2024, OpenAI has leveraged Databricks in Azure and AWS, with usage data landing in Delta tables governed by Unity Catalog . Databricks Jobs and Data Warehouses transform that data through layered pipelines to serve product analytics, finance, security, and trust, and safety teams.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Provides access control, governance, and lineage across OpenAI's shared data products and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores OpenAI's curated datasets for analytics, machine learning, and operational use cases.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, interactive analysis, and governed SQL workloads for business users at OpenAI.

solution_components.name: Genie
solution_components.role: Lets nontechnical teams at OpenAI query governed data in natural language.

solution_components.name: Databricks Jobs
solution_components.role: Runs scheduled transformation jobs that publish datasets for downstream teams.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data Warehouses
solution_components.role: Provides warehouse compute for cross-functional reporting and governed analytics.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks and is transformed through managed pipelines stored in Delta Lake under Unity Catalog governance before being served through Databricks SQL, Genie
